editorial.blurb: Taqueria Los Altos delivers authentic Mexican flavors with uncommonly fresh ingredients and a genuine neighborhood spirit.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the pastor tacos and ask for extra salsa on the side — reviewers rave about the meat but note that salsa doesn't always come automatically.
